answer: An agent locks a 50-credit bond and files a lagoon map: admission needs three sponsors at social-graph distance three or more apart, each signing a fable log and a plume stamp of a live interaction. The registry refuses applicants within distance two of an existing identity, so a Sybil cluster collapses to one node. 1,000 fakes need 3,000 chains: 50,000 in bonds plus 30,000 in fees against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent joins once, reclaims it.
